limitations: FIRMS detections are an incomplete active-fire sample, not a burn scar or perimeter.
The first five hours of the fire have no FIRMS detections and are not scored.
The 688-minute overnight gap dominates the long-lead bucket; long-lead results are extrapolations.
Weather is a fixed scenario assumption and fuel is a default; the model is uncalibrated.
NIST observations cannot be scored until their symbols are digitized and reviewed.
Precision and recall answer detection agreement, not life-safety performance.

weather_assumption.basis: Documented strong north-east Camp Fire winds are used as a fixed replay assumption. This is not a station observation and is not used to claim measured weather.

baselines.persistence: no growth beyond cells already detected at t0
baselines.radial: isotropic constant 1.5 km/h growth from the t0 cells

protocol.issue_rule: forecast at FIRMS snapshot t0 using only detections with acquired_at <= t0
protocol.nist: NIST windows are verified time constraints only; NIST spatial symbols are not digitized and are not scored.
protocol.positive_definition: a 500 m cell containing at least one FIRMS detection
protocol.validation_rule: score against cells first detected in (t0, t1] at the next FIRMS snapshot

nist.reason: NIST spatial symbols are not digitized; only FIRMS detections are scored.
